signals.summary: Tripadvisor cut about 20% of its workforce while merging Tripadvisor and Viator operations.
An $85 million cost-savings program runs through 2026 and into 2027.
Viator revenue grew 9% to $295M and TheFork 28% to $63M, while core Tripadvisor declined.
Layoffs tied to merging overlapping engineering, product and technology teams after the Viator merger.
Activist investors Starboard Value and Palliser Capital pressed for strategic changes or a sale.
